name: Weather
reason: Folks, this week's forecast is a mixed bag for blue-greens: mid-August warmth at 27.1C is decent, but zero days above 30C and a hefty 29.7 mm of rain would stir and flush the water, so I'm leaning against a bloom.
evidence: Average max temperature of 27.1C is warm but below the 30C threshold that favours blooms
Zero hot days (>30C) this week, so no sustained heat spike
Rain total of 29.7 mm is enough to mix and flush the water column
Mid-August timing keeps some seasonal bloom potential alive
